Stockroom — Inventory Management Dashboard

Track stock across branches, get low-stock alerts and log deliveries.

Platform

Proposed tools
Planned: Node.js API · SQLite · Vanilla JS front end
THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

Small shops track inventory in notebooks or spreadsheets and run out of best sellers without warning.

DESIGN APPROACH

Approach

Planned as an extension of this repo’s Node API: products, stock movements and low-stock thresholds. UI designed first.

Key features

  • 01Stock table with low-stock highlights
  • 02Delivery and adjustment logs
  • 03Per-branch view
  • 04CSV export (planned)
